hero.titleLine1: Every photo holds a moment worth
hero.description: We started Milestis because photos get lost — buried in a camera roll, or locked inside an app that might not exist in five years. So we built a place where they actually stay found.
hero.imageAlt: A printed photo book laid open on a table

manifesto.quote: The struggle of man against power is the struggle of memory against forgetting.
manifesto.author: Milan Kundera

permanence.title: Still here, long after the feed moves on.

items.title: Share it your way
items.description: A public link, a small circle, or just you — you're always the one who decides who sees it.

items.title: Ready in one click
items.description: Hand it a folder of photos and it comes back looking like someone actually designed it.

items.title: It doesn't expire
items.description: No subscription to keep paying, no algorithm to keep up with. It keeps working for as long as you want it to.

cta.title: Give your photos somewhere to stay.
cta.description: Bring your photos. Leave with something that lasts.
